name: profile.compare
title: profile.compare
summary: Compare p95 against a saved baseline.
html:
Compare p95 against a saved baseline.

  • Scope: read
  • Service: profile
  • MCP: ara_profile with "action": "compare"

#Params

ParamRequiredDescription
sessionyesCalling Engine Protocol session.
baselineyesSaved baseline summary as a JSON string.
currentCurrent summary as a JSON string; omitted uses the live rolling capture.
relativeAllowed fractional p95 increase (default 0.05).
absoluteNsAllowed absolute increase in nanoseconds (default 1000).
